did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/planning/spec.md, tasks/planning/dev.json and the number/exact/json checker code in lab/core.py
Wrote 21 single-mode tasks g5-01..g5-21 (7 easy, 7 medium, 7 hard) with a Python build script
Validated with lab/validate_tasks.py: 21/21 valid (every reference passes, every negative fails)

easy: money left after a quantity list
only boat meeting seat and price limits (JSON after working)
first step that cannot be paid from a purse
medium: cheapest drum+flute pair under a weight limit (JSON after working)
units limited by cart weight rather than money
overspend with a conditional delivery fee
first step breaking a daily cap or running-total rule
rule audit where the broken rule needs the plan total
money left after choosing pass vs single tickets
hard: only triple of items summing exactly to a voucher
best points under a budget where greedy fails
cheapest 3-part kit with warmth minimum and banned pairing
units under tiered pricing after a fee
remove one optional line to fit budget with highest total
most children given ticket prices and a bus size choice
overspend with per-person, per-day and per-night multipliers

answer_verification: Every expected answer is computed and asserted in the build script: arithmetic by direct evaluation, uniqueness and optimality by brute force (all pairs, all 3-item subsets, all subsets under budget, all 8 kits, all child counts per bus), step audits by simulating the plan, and the tempting wrong answer for each negative is computed too (greedy result, money-only limit, cheapest invalid combination).
checker_notes: 19 tasks use the number checker on an ANSWER line holding one number; 2 tasks (g5-05, g5-08) use a non-strict json object check with keys and equals after plain-text working that contains no braces or brackets
No two-option answers; rule and step questions have 3 to 5 candidates

Negatives are the most tempting error: unit price without quantity, ignoring the fixed fee, reporting the total instead of the excess, cheapest pair or kit that breaks a rule, money-only limit, rounding down weeks, greedy pick
not_done: No model pilot was run on these tasks (held-out by instruction), so the easy/medium/hard labels are estimates from the spec's baseline guidance, not measured. Other generators' files were not read, so overlap with them is unchecked.
